title: Dynamic Repair and Maintenance of Heterogeneous Machines Dispersed on a Network: A Rollout Method for Online Reinforcement Learning
summary: We consider a problem in which a single repairer is responsible for the maintenance and repair of a collection of machines, positioned at different locations on a network of nodes and edges. Machines deteriorate according to stochastic processes and incur increasing costs as they approach complete failure. The times needed for repairs to be performed, and the amounts of time needed for the repairer to switch between different machines, are random and machine-dependent. The problem is formulated as a Markov decision process (MDP) in which the objective is to minimize long-run average costs.…
